title: Set up a project tracker
summary: Configure the project tracker with projects, teams, labels, and workflows. Linear is the canonical route; the project-management arena ranks the alternatives.

parts.title: Create the project tracker workspace
parts.guidance: Find the company's existing account or create the workspace in the selected tracker. Set the company name, administrator, recovery contact, and default visibility, keeping customer or confidential work restricted as needed. Use the agreed plan and seat budget; new paid commitments need the budget owner's approval. Add the workspace link to onboarding and identify the administrator teammates should contact for access or configuration changes.

parts.title: Configure workflow states
parts.guidance: Map how work enters the queue, becomes accepted, moves through execution and review, and reaches completion. Give each state a clear meaning and make blocked, cancelled, and completed work distinguishable. Configure the states the team needs, then walk an actual representative task through them to find unclear transitions. If the tracker already contains work, map old states to new ones before changing anything that would strand active issues.

parts.title: Create teams and projects
parts.guidance: Create tracker teams where membership, ownership, or workflows genuinely differ. Use projects for concrete initiatives, each with a stated outcome and accountable owner. Link existing tasks to their new projects and team owners. Set visibility for each team and project, and check that teammates can find their active work from the main workspace. Keep unowned initiatives in a visible planning queue until someone takes responsibility.

parts.title: Set up labels
parts.guidance: Choose labels for distinctions the team needs to filter or triage, such as work type or affected product area. Keep status and ownership in their dedicated fields. Give ambiguous labels a short definition and merge near-duplicates. Apply the proposed set to a few current issues with the triage owner; disagreements will reveal which definitions need tightening before the label list spreads.

parts.title: Invite team members
parts.guidance: Compare the team roster with current tracker members and prepare invitations for the missing people. Match each person to the right team and role, checking administrator permissions and any additional seat cost. Ask the tracker administrator to check the list and seat impact, then send access instructions with the team's workflow guide. Follow up on failed invitations and help the first new member find and update a real assigned task.

metadata.supportReason: Linear has a comprehensive GraphQL API and MCP integration. Full workspace setup automatable.
